notes.title: = 9.10 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,
This week's update is packed with exciting content! Miya knows you have been waiting eagerly, so let's get straight to the good stuff!

[b]=Major Upgrade · Visual Feast=[/b]
[u]The "All Angels Evolution" project is complete![/u]
The models of all the Angels who have been accompanying you have undergone a comprehensive remaster and upgrade! Everything, from their movements to the finest details, has been completely revamped!
[u]A/B/C-tier Angels · Revamped characters Art Debuts![/u]
We have also replaced and optimized the character art for Angels of the corresponding tiers. Both their appearance and temperament have been greatly enhanced!

To this day, Angel Legion is able to shine even more brilliantly, and this would not have been possible without every Commander who has accompanied and supported us along the way! (Miya is sending a thousand manual heartfelt thanks here ❤)

Please look forward to tomorrow's new version and witness the brand-new charm of the Angels with your own eyes! See you in the game!

Below is the official update preview for all commanders to review.
[b]=Maintenance Time=[/b]
[u]September 10, 14:00 - 16:00 (GMT+8)[/u]

[b]=Maintenance Compensation=[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]=Important Notes=[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. Commander need to download and install the latest version of the game package on Store.
3. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]=Feature Adjustment=[/b]
1. Upgraded the models of all heroes; fully replaced the art for A-tier, B-tier, and C-tier heroes.
2. Adjusted the hero details interface and added a new "Senki" tab, which will include appearance and story functions.
3. Adjusted the display of story dialogues, added interactive storylines, and applied dynamic character art for dialogue characters.
4. [u]Removed the fashion shop from Star Adventure. After the update, the Star Adventure maps and adventure events progress of all Commanders will be forcibly refreshed.[/u]
5. Unlocked the custom makeup function for all heroes.
6. Adjusted the animation effects during the recruitment process.
7. Enhanced the classification display of chat messages and supported adjusting the priority of notifications in settings.
8. Added an in-game volume adjustment function.
9. Adjusted the display of the pre-battle interface for the main storyline.
10. Adjusted the handling method for resource overflow to resolve the frequent overflow issue of Star Coupon and Force.

[b]=System Optimization=[/b]
1. Optimized model and scene resources to improve expressive quality.
2. Optimized the scene display of the pre-battle interface for the main storyline.
3. Optimized the display of Miya's promotion process.
4. Optimized the display of the hero transpose function.
5. Added higher-resolution setting options.

notes.title: [Angel Legion] The Sixth Anniversary Celebration Event # Welfare Overview!
notes.content:
The stars shine bright — the celebration is upon us!

Six years have passed like fireflies slipping through the cracks of time — swift and fleeting. Yet our interstellar epic has only just begun to unveil its grandest chapter.

Standing before this golden milestone, let us write with passion as our pen, and continue to engrave the brilliance that is ours to claim.

Happy 6th Anniversary, Commanders! May our banners forever soar into the deep starry sea — anchored by trust, driven by belief — as we embark on the next dazzling journey across light-years!

[b]"Angel Legion" will officially launch 6th-anniversary celebration on June 27, 2025![/b]

[b]During the celebration, the game will provide a wealth of benefits. The main event content is as follows:[/b]
1. After the maintenance, the limited-time 3D scene 'Veil of Obscura'' will be showcased for three days.
2. The game will launch an anniversary sign-in event on June 27th, with 60 Adv. Recruit Device and Rare S Gene Choice Chest available, free to get!
3. During the anniversary celebration, commanders can participate in active events to obtain anniversary recruit items for free, with a chance to acquire 40+ Recruit chances.
4. If Commanders:
(1) [u]Complete 258 Advanced Recruitment tasks, can get the Butterfly Girl Gene.[/u]
(2) [u]Complete 400 Advanced Recruitment tasks, can get the Deadly Shadow Gene.[/u]
(3) [u]Complete 600 Advanced Recruitment tasks, can get the ​Eternal Prism Gene.[/u]
5. During the anniversary celebration, the Champions' Battle S8 event will be launched. Participate in the event and claim exclusive avatar frame rewards.
6. The double diamond rewards for the first star dollar purchase will soon reset after the maintenance.
7. During the anniversary celebration, the rewards for the Gift of the Brave(Endless Trial) will be increased.
8. [u]The First-month Day Check-in rewards will be adjusted. After the server maintenance is completed, the First-month Day Check-in progress will be reset. Commanders who have already claimed all rewards can also re-claim the check-in rewards.[/u]
9. The "SALE" will launch new products and offer limited-time discounts on a variety of items to celebrate the anniversary.

notes.title: "Prism Awakening" — Naiveer
notes.content:
[b]"What lights a fire in the dark... may not be hope."[/b]

[b]※ Character Profile[/b]
*Height: 174cm*    *Weight: 55kg*    *Birth: 4.10*    *BWH: 93-64-98*

Slumbering consciousness awakened from the Eastern "Mirror Abyss." Reshaped into human form by an interstellar rift. Channels hybrid energy of ancient "Prismagic" and cosmic civilization—a bridge between reality and void. Commands prismatic magic via enchanted wand.

[b]※ Character Ability — Omni-Control[/b]
There seems to be a resonance between her and her "Mirror Magic Wand"—before each spell is cast, it's as if she's conversing with the prism. She doesn't pursue destructive power, but focuses on precision and strangeness, with victory often built on cognitive manipulation of "knowing thy enemy and thyself.

notes.title: = 11.27 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]13:00 PM November 27th, 2024(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 3 hours

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*450

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= Update Content =[/b]
= Feature Adjustments =
1. Server Merge Rule Changes: [u]After merged servers, the Arena/Simulated Alpha will retain Local Ranking and Rewards[/u].
(1) New Tourney rank and Tourney Rewards have been added, merged servers will be considered as one Tournament.
(2) No Compensation Mail will be sent after the server merge.
2. New S+ Hero: Moonlit Phantom.
(1) Attack Range: All units.
(2) Hero Skill: Allows all allied heroes to gain lifesteal effects.
(3) [u]First Real Human Hero[/u], S+ hero can evolve to higher level, with a maximum upgrade level of 460.
(4) The Rebate Package from 4 to 7 has added this Hero Shard as a reward. Commanders who have already claimed the Rebate Package  will receive a compensation through email.
3. New Addition of Punk Guitar in the Hero's Shard Pack - Normal Package.
4. Added Scroll Bar to the Fashion List.
5. Added Preview Function to the Hero Gene Item Information Interface.
6. Chat Function Unlock Level Raised to Level 15, Added 5s Speaking Cooldown.
7. New MSAA Settings Feature.
8. Removed 45 FPS Option.
9. Added German and French.

= System Improvements =
1. Fixed the bug that occurred when clicking back during Recruit.
2. Adaptation for foldable screens.
3. Fixed the error with the left hand finger in the Fashion – Peak Speed.

notes.title: = 12.13 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]13:00 PM December 13th, 2023(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 2 hours

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= Update Content =[/b]
= Function Adjustments =
1. Added new live 2D scenes for "Deadly Shadow" and "Shura Killer".
2. Updated arts for "Element Spirit" and "Punk Guitar".
3. Both Privilege rewards are now distributed via game mail.
4. Adjusted fashion and glasses wearing functionality.
5. Added countdown reminders for time-limited event item drops on the Botting Interface and Adventure map.
6. "Advance" function in Biological Cabin now unlocks at resonance level 160.
7. Added the ability to view information for each legion in the legion list.
8. Players can challenge the final stage of Legion Dungeon again after completing it.
9. Modified the function to claim rewards for Daily/Weekly Mission, Instructor's Guidance, and Adventure Progress. Now, clicking any claim button will automatically claim all available rewards at once.
10. Added refresh countdown reminder to the Weekly Mission.
11. Increased the English announcement text limit for legions to 200 characters.
12. Changed the reward (Gene Box) for Hunter ID Card to be manually opened by players in the Storage.
13. Fixed the cumulative recharge/consumption of Star Credits counting bug.
14. Both Privileges, Hunter ID Card, and Secret Treasures are now purchased by cash.

= System Improvements =
1. Optimized the effects of recruiting S-class heroes on the recruitment results interface.
2. Improved lineup saving mechanism when switching servers with the same account.
3. Enhanced the announcement interface.
4. Optimized the battle result interface.
5. Improved the interface for exciting events.
6. Enhanced some guidance tutorials of Adventure Map.
7. Improved the icons for some items.
8. Optimized offline friend sorting on the Friends interface, with longer offline times placed further down the list.
9. Optimized the layout and text content of some interfaces.

notes.title: = 8.23 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]13:00 PM August 23th, 2023(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 2 hours

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= Update Content =[/b]
= Function Adjustments =
1. Updated the card artwork for the following heroes:【Powerful Mage】, 【Gentle Healer】, 【Mental Healing】, 【Justice Knight】, 【Sword Master】, 【Flame Witch】, 【Raging Angel】, 【Sakura Dancer】, 【Arcane Scholar】, 【Hell Scythe】.
2. Added full-body live 2D illustrations for the following characters:【Powerful Mage】, 【Gentle Healer】, 【Justice Knight】, 【Flame Witch】, 【Raging Angel】, 【Arcane Scholar】, 【Hell Scythe】.
3. Updated the model for【Gentle Healer】.
4. Optimized the selection interface for using hero genes in evolving and advancing.
5. Added New Legion Gameplay - Virtual Battlefield: Miya will challenge the new Alpha with three different artifacts, and the rankings will be based on the combined highest damage dealt by all Legion members.
6. Added display of the top five ranks for Virtual Battlefield in the Adventure Map's Hall of Fame.

= System Improvements =
1. The interface for customizing character appearance and taking photos now hides UAV and elf.
2. Optimized several UI elements and text content.

notes.title: =Angel Legion= Version Update Notice(5.9)
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]13:00 PM May 9th, 2023(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 4 Hours

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*600

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

= What’s New =
Function Updates
1. Hero and Elf Card Modifications.
(1) All A, B, C grade heroes have updated card art.
(2) The following S heroes have updated card art: [The Sergeant], [Sword Master], [Ghost Princess], [Shining Girl], [Shy Girl] and [Element Sprite].
2. Added a hero card appreciation feature. A "card appreciation" button has been added to the hero details page.
3. Modified the Endless Trial gameplay. The current progress and achievement rewards will be reset.
4. Optimized the layout of the activity page.
5. Added a music appreciation feature to the Living Cabin.
6. Added Miya watering and painting storylines to the Living Cabin.
7. Added a new Honor Hall element to the adventure map, which displays the winners of the previous round of Champions Battle activity.

System Optimization
1. Optimized memory puzzle and storyline images.
2. Optimized some hero and Elf icons.
3. Optimized the sorting rules of dynamic scene pages, and increased the priority of unlocked dynamic scenes.

notes.title: =Angel Legion= Version Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from 13:00 PM January 6th, 2023(GMT/UTC+8).
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]=Estimated Maintenance Time=[/b]
[u]1 hour and 30 minutes[/u]

[b]=Maintenance Compensation=[/b]
[u]Diamonds*300[/u]

[b]=TIPS=[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]=Update Content=[/b]
[u]Function Adjustment[/u]
1. Added Justice Blade - Hinata Rin into Gene Pool, Yellow Crystal Store and Hero Katana Gene Chest.
2. Added a new function of recording player’s birthday(unlocked when the intimacy level with Miya reaches lv. 4) and we’ve prepared a surprise in the living cabin on that day.
3. Added new holiday scenes for Chinese New Year and Valentine’s Day in the living cabin, which can be interacted with during the holiday.
4. Added combo animation off function, players can now go to the setting interface to switch off the animation.

[u]System Optimization[/u]
1. Fixed the alert bug of daily giftpack and double-week giftpack.
2. Fixed a bug that the details were not displayed by long pressing the skill icon during the battle.
3. Fixed the extra healing performance bug of the Ghost Princess skill during the battle.
4. Fixed a bug where Miya’s hairstyle changed automatically to the default setting due to switching fashion.

notes.title: = 11.1 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]14:00 PM November 1st, 2022(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 2 hours

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= What's New =[/b]
[u]Function Adjustment[/u]
1. Added Home System, enter the living cabin and experience the little bits and pieces of living with Miya.
(In addition, unlock various items in the living cabin to see the unknown side of Miya.)
2. The Temple of Zeus is removed from the dynamic scene and replaced with a new one.
3. Added a reward for being an official account.
4. Replaced the fashion reward for clearing the first chapter with a new one.

[u]=System Optimization=[/u]
1. Fixed a bug where defeating warlords wasn’t counted in Weekly Mission by using the Cruise function.
2. Fixed a bug where Justice Blade’s skill didn’t display the number of damage after defeating enemies in battle.
3. Updated the character figure of some heroes.
4. Optimized some texts.

notes.title: OUT FOR JUSTICE # New Rare S Angel - Hinata Rin
notes.content:
[b]=Background Story=[/b]
Hinata Rin, a ninja killer from the East. Her shady identity made her used to playing solo and being alone and never had too much contact with the outside world.
However, Hinata Rin, who seems to be cold and ruthless, has the fire of justice burning in her heart. She dreams that the world will eventually meet the so-called “Peace” through her continuous efforts to eliminate all the evil leaders who disrupt the order. This belief becomes the driving force for her to constantly improve her skills, the short katana is her most used weapon and her closest friend. Her slim body and dexterous movements enable her to sneak to the target without even noticing, and with her extraordinary killer instinct, she can kill the enemy only in one hit.

[b]=Skill Introduction=[/b]
[Basic] Attack: Deal physical damage to a single enemy in the front row.

[Active Skill] Warth Blades: Deal physical damage with a chance to cause Blind effect.

[Combo Skill] Super. Warth Blades: Deal physical damage to the enemy in the front row with a chance to cause Blind effect. Cannot be resisted (Artifact bonus damage).

[Passive Skill 1] Shadow Walk: Whenever the enemy's attack misses you, your next attack crit increases.

[Passive Skill 2] Keen Awareness: Whenever the enemy's attack misses you, your own crit damage increases.

notes.title: = 7.19 Version Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from [u]13:00 PM July 19th, 2022(GMT/UTC+8)[/u].
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]= Duration =[/b]
About 1 hours 30 minutes

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= What's New =[/b]
[u]Function Adjustment[/u]
1. Added the avatar of Time Jumper - Euphyris.
2. Added new Cruise function in the Adventure:
a)When the Master Cabin reaches level 6, the Cruise is enabled.
b)While using Cruise function the spacecraft AI can help the commander to explore the elements in the star map. Hands Free!
c)These elements can be automatically explored by Cruise: Adventurers, Wanted Criminals, Ancient Ruins, Space Drift Boxes, Space Warlords, Space Stations, Old Space Stations, Giant Meteorites, Large Force Crystals, Large Crystal Mines, Factories, Space Clothing Stores, Other Players Ships, Pirates, Heroic Altars, Transport Ships, Large Battleships, Predators, Space Capsules, Star Chest.
3. Modified the loading interface for scene switching.

[u]System Optimization[/u]
1. Fixed a bug that caused Text Bubble error of reminding to unlock new fashion, when you get back from Resonance Palace.
2. Fixed a bug that caused the model error after customizing the appearance.
3. Fixed a bug that caused the performance issue after clearing the artifact dungeon.
4. Fixed a bug where you couldn't turn off the sound of your spaceships in the Adventure.
5. Fixed a bug where the interface went wrong while you clinked on the model during evolving.
6. Optimized the display of your Resonance Level in the Evolve.
7. Added a one-time tip for the Roulette action at the first time entering the Adventure.
8. Optimized some texts.

notes.title: = Angel Legion = Version Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear commanders, 
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from 13:00 PM May 24th, 2022(GMT/UTC+8).
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]Duration[/b]
About 2 Hours

[b]Maintenance Compensation[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]TIPS[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]= What’s New =[/b]
- Function Adjustment -
1. Added the appearance customization of Miya before enter the game.
2. Added the share function of appearance data, you can use others appearance data in game.
3. Modified the unlock condition of artifact, all artifacts are unlocked in chapter 1.
4. Modified the function list on hero page. Appearance is changed to enter by tapping the hero model and the skill is remove from evolve page to the function list.
5. Modified the default mode of fight as auto-fight. Manual combat and commander Item is opened in chapter 2.
6. Modified the movement method in adventure. You can move the spaceship by control the roulette and consume no fuel.
7. Added 7 days sign-in gift for novice. The sign-in gift in tutorial is changed as 7 days sign-in function.
8. Added the recruit event for novice. The event will be opened when the account is level 4, you can claim the rewards by completing the Adv. Recruit missions.
9. Added daily optional hero’s shard pack, remove the packs in recharge diamond and time-limited packs for clearing chapters.
10. Modified the unlock condition of advance in biological cabin. It will be opened when the account is level 30.
11. Added mainline chapter to chapter 84.
12. Added endless trial stage to stage 840.
13. Added battlefield stage to stage 1800.
14. The customization of makeup, hairstyle and etc. is unlocked by default. And the makeup element in endless trial is canceled. (After update, the process of endless trial will be reset for all players.)

- System Optimization -
1. Optimized the guide prompt effect of the novice tutorial.
2. Added a one-time guide prompt to some functions.
3. Optimized the button position of the fashion details interface.
4. Optimized the function description text layout of the cabin interface.
5. Optimized part of the description text.

notes.title: =Angel Legion= 3.17 Version Update Notice
notes.content:
[b]= Key Content in Update =[/b]
In the next version, we have done a big update in art to perform better effect.
And this change means a lot to us as well as the commanders who support us all the long way until now!
So, we are really excited to share this news with you guys right away!

[b]= Update Time =[/b]
March 17th 14:00-16:00(UTC/GMT+8)

[b]= Maintenance Compensation =[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]= TIPS =[/b]
-Please close the game before the maintenance to make sure you can update the game later.
-After the game is maintaining, you need to download the latest game update file.
-When you finish the installation, wait to the end of maintenance, then you can get into the game as usual.

[b]= Update Content =[/b]
[b]= For S Hero =[/b]
Arcane Scholar - Riana can be obtained by Gene Pool and Yellow Crystal.

[b]= Function Adjustment =[/b]
1. The Pray function has evolved to the Palace function. We remain the bless effect in pray and add a resonance system, which can automatically level up the heroes for free.
2. Modification in Endless Trial:
a) Added a Fight button and you can challenge the stage directly.
b) Added the number of times of roulette, at the beginning of each zone, you have certain times to use the roulette, and can get extra times by victory in battle.
c) Removed non-compulsory combat events from map events.
d) Increased the number of event that can recover health.
3. Modified the condition of unlocking the exclusive fashion of SS equipment. When you get any piece of an SS equipment set, you can unlock the exclusive fashion which all heroes are able to wear.
4. Raised the top limit of hero and you can evolve hero to a new higher stage, legend gold, which use the hero’s SS gene to evolve.
5. Optimized some of the dynamic scene in the hall.
6. Modified the condition to unlock some of dynamic scenes in the hall:
a) Girl in the Cabin was adjusted from Clearance 1-3 to Clearance 20-10.
b) Hilti's Advice was adjusted from Clearance 1-3 to Clearance 19-6.
c) Combat Meeting was adjusted from Clearance 1-3 to Clearance 19-10.
7. Added the exclusive fashion of Miya.
8. Modified the recruit function, if you get the hero for the first time, the genes will turn the new hero automatically.
9. Removed the male character in B and C class, they are invisible on the hero list and can’t be obtained in game anymore. (Gotten ones remain.)
10. Added 3 female characters in B class.
11. Removed the appearance customization before enter the game.
12. Added the special reward preview and claiming prompt in the Road of Novice.
13. After recharging star dollars, there will show the rebate points you got.
14. Added the entrance of guide on the main quest interface. 

[b]= System Optimization =[/b]
1. Optimized the art resources, including character models and scene effect.
2. The rank in Endless Trial is folded by default and will not be auto-opened.
3. Fixed the dismiss function of hero in B and C class.
4. Fixed the incorrect unlock prompt message when customize the appearance.
5. Fixed the problem in Battlefield that part of the enemies in the battle didn’t match as they show.
6. Optimized part of the text.

[b]= Contact Us =[/b]
E-mail: xingfei6661@gmail.com
Facebook: @AngelLegionOfficial
Discord: Angel Legion#1464

notes.title: = Angel Legion 2nd Anniversary = Part.1 「Reset」 — Flash Back
notes.content:
Dear commanders, 
Let’s celebrate the coming of 2nd Anniversary!
It’s so exciting to travel and adventure together for 2 years. And Miya is really grateful to all the company and support from our commanders. 
There is a long way for our journey, we will try our best to continue!
During the anniversary period, we will release lots of events.
Here is the preview of event update content.
= Duration = 
June. 24  14:00—16:00(UTC/GMT+8)
= Update Preview =
1. Free 60 summons in special recruit in anniversary events.
Commanders can participate in anniversary events after the update in Friday this week, and you can get 60 summons for free as most. (By Daily Sign-in, Adventure Mission, Adventure Drop, Looting and etc.)
2. The first recharge double diamonds reset.
The first recharge double diamonds will be reset after the maintenance of update.
3. The chapter package reset.
The chapter package will be reset after the maintenance of update.
(1. The time for purchasing the package is only 12 hours.)
(2. If a player completed all the chapters, the limited package for completed chapters will be reset.)
4. The brand new SS equipment-Eternalnight Sets released.
The brand new SS equipment-Eternalnight Sets will be released after the maintenance of update.(In 2nd Anniversary Game Event)
Here are some details for new SS equipment:
a) The attributes of the SS equipment are similar to those of the super S equipment, but each piece of SS equipment has a new special effect when release normal attack. When an angel with SS equipment, she has a chance to cause various debuffs during normal attack;
b) When an angel equipped with a set of SS equipment, she can activate the exclusive fashion of the equipment;
c) SS equipment can be obtained by collecting shards of SS equipment and 100 shards can activate a piece of random SS equipment. We will set more ways for commanders to get the shard, and during the anniversary we will send 20 shards of SS equipment free on the 7th day in daily sign-in.
d) Limited set of package will be released during the anniversary, you can get a set of SS equipment(Eternalnight Sets) after purchasing the whole set of package.
Part of information for the 2nd anniversary is shown as above. For more information please refer to follow notice.
Last but not the least, appreciate to all the support for Angel Legion and Miya, which is the best encouragement for us to make it better.
Happy birthday to Angel Legion!

notes.title: = Update Announcement =
notes.content:
Dear commanders,
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from 14:00 PM Jun 16th, 2021(GMT/UTC+8).
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

= Duration =
About 3 Hours

= Maintenance Compensation =
Diamonds*450

= TIPS =
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

= What’s New =
Function Adjustment
1. The Upgrade and Skill under hero details are merged into one entrance.
2. The condition of unlocking artifact is changed into unlocking by passing specified levels (players who have already unlocked artifacts prior to the update stays unlocked).
3. Artifact dungeon optimization, the difficulty of the first few levels is reduced. Ranking rules are also optimized, team with higher CP ranks higher when teams are in the same level.
4. Adjustment on daily rewards of endless trail, the original fixed number of star coupons and force is changed to time chest.
5. Horcard avatar is added into avatar list.
6. Random items have been added to the daily store, with the possibility of reset injection.
7. Adjustment on exchangeable items in mall.
8. New function, quick recruitment is added under legion hall for leader and deputy leader. 
9. Ranking view function for galaxy war is added into the interface of legion application.
10. Commanders can now find friends via UID in the friend system.

System Optimization
1. Fixed the bug that when you click commander item immediately after manually engaging into combat, enemy’s No.1 hero won’t be able to release skill even if the hero has enough energy.
2. Fixed the bug that 3D model of the fire elf doesn’t match its 2D icon.
3. Fixed the bug that shows the number of legion members as 0 after creating a legion.
4. Cancelled the quality mark that should not appear on the elf detail page.
5. Fixed the bug that when giving gifts to newly added friends, system prompts server message error.
6. In the settlement interface of advanced recruitment, commanders can directly buy advanced recruit devices with diamonds if commanders don’t have enough of it.
7. Optimized the function of increasing the quantity under the purchase interface of the legion store, now it will not exceed the maximum quantity that can be purchased.
8. Fixed the bug that puzzle prompt still appears after the memory puzzle is all put together.
9. Fixed the bug which appeared when grabbing multiple Hongbao continuously in the interface of grabbing Hongbao.
10. Fixed the bug about the interface error occurred after clicking recruit from the hero list and then entering the production cabin to view the details of any equipment.
11. Optimized the numerical display of CP which shall only be displayed when it’s up to K units.
12. Added the feedback notice for legion invite in the chat.
13. Optimized the GIF effect of Horcard-Cleopatra.
14. Optimized part of the interface layout.
15. Optimized part of the description text.

notes.title: Q&A Episode 1
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your attention and support to Angel Legion. We have always cared about the player's gaming experience.
Recently, we have received some suggestions and questions about the game from players. Now, we will give our answer:

Q1: Is it possible to add the function of using UID to find friends?
A1: No problem. In future version, you could search a player by both nickname and UID in the search box

Q2: Can the sales limit of Reset Injection be increased?
A2: Considering the commanders’ demand for Reset Injection, in future versions, we will provide Reset Injection in the Daily Shop. Commanders can purchase it in the Daily Shop.

Q3: The difficulty of Artifact Dungeon increased too fast, and most players are stuck in Stage 3 or Stage 4. The progress of everyone in the Rank is the same. Can this problem be improved?
A3: We will appropriately adjust the difficulty gradient of Artifact Dungeon to allow players to get better ranking results.

Q4: Too little Rewards of Endless Trail. In the middle and late game, this reward has no real value.
A4: We will adjust the types and quantities of daily rewards so that commanders feel that this reward is worthy to click Endless Trial and receive it.

Q5: Legion is very troublesome to recruit new people. We can only post Legion's name in the chat, and then wait for interested players to search. How can we improve this situation so that active Legion can recruit new player more conveniently?
Q5: Good question. We plan to develop a new feature that allows Legion members to post the application button in the chat channel, and the commander can click the button to jump to the interface for applying to join the Legion.

Q6: The current recruitment of Legion will only be sorted by rank. Unless you join the Legion, you will not see the Galaxy War rankings. After you leave the Legion, you will have a cooldown if you want to join the Legion again.
A6: he Legion function has been greatly improved after the version change, but the Legion recruitment function has not changed. We will add Galaxy War rankings to the leaderboard or Lgion recruitment interface for your commanders' reference.

Q7: Each new activity is a skin-changing version of the old one, too many similar activities can make people feel tired.
A7: Designing new forms and contents of activities requires a long development time. Commanders, please be patient, we will launch more interesting new activities.

Q8: The function of Rapid Loot is affected by the level of the main control room, which makes the catalyst difficult to consume in the middle and late stages and loses its significance as a resource alone.
A8: Rapid Loot is an important source for players to obtain Star Coupon, Force and other resources. We will carefully consider how to modify this function.

Q9: There is the situation of stun resistance in the game, but it can only be obtained by selecting a specific talent. Can you increase the source of this attribute?
A9: In order to change situation where the stun hero is too powerful, we decided to add the attribute of stun resistance. Considering that most players have already cultivated a team with stun heroes as the core, we will not immediately put many stun resistance attributes, which is unfair to them. In the future, we will use Horcard to gradually increase the amount of stun resistance.

Q10: Rewards of the 30th level of Expedition is too few. The current reward is a little triangle crystal, diamond, or alloy. As the last level, rewards should be more valuable.
A10: As a permanent activity, the rewards of the Expedition will greatly affect the commanders' resource acquisition. If we only increase the rewards of level 30, it will gradually widen the gap between low-level players and high-level players. This change has a greater impact and we will consider it carefully.

notes.title: ========Update Announcement========
notes.content:
Dear Commanders, 
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from 2:00 PM on January 27th, 2021(GMT/UTC+8).
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

Estimated Maintenance Time
2 Hours

Maintenance Compensation
Diamonds*300

TIPS
1. Please close the game and download the game update file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the update file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.
3. If you encounter a BUG in the new version of the game, please give us feedback in time.
======== Update Preview ========

Function Adjustment
1. New System: Horcard Collection System. Collecting exquisite Horcards to activate special attributes. (Please pay attention to follow-up Event of collecting Horcard)
2. Road of Novice is modified to Instructor’s Guidance (Players who have completed the Road of Novice could participate again after update)
3. First Recharge reward is modified to First Recharge 3-Day Reward. (Players who have received the First Recharge rewards could receive the rewards of Day 2 and Day 3)
4. Add specialization mark to every hero.
5. Removed the number of Gene shown in the Hero interface.
6. Upgrade the Storage Cabin to increase the capacity of equipment.
7. Add the avatar of the current equipment wearer on the equipment replacement interface.
8. Strengthen the performance of wear button of the Fashion interface.
9. Announced the success probability of equipment enhancement and the probability of obtaining Super S Equipment.
10. Added the function of adding designated friends.
11. Chat system optimized. Allow more text input, and add a new system message channel to isolate the system message from the world chat.
12. Block the Fashion interface when customizing Miya for the first time in a new account.
13. Automatic Battle and Skip Battle in the Adventure will be available at Stage 2-1.
14. Commander Items can be sold to get Star Coupons.
15. When you cancel the production of a waiting project, you will reclaim all consumed resources.
16. New function added: Lock the Dynamic Senses. Choose the dynamic senses and lock them. Only locked Dynamic Senses will be shown.
17. New function added: Skip Cutscene. You can skip the cutscene when you open a chest in the Botting-Chest interface.
18. Added a gyroscope switch in the settings. You can freely turn on or turn off the gyroscope.
19. Added a batch of custom hair styles.
20. The Christmas theme scene will be unavailable, and a new theme scene will be available during the Spring Festival.

System Optimization
1. Fix the problem that "incorrect production time" may appear when producing items in the cabin.
2. Fixed a bug where clicking the upper right corner during the animation to the next chapter will return to the main interface.
3. Fixed the bug that the map turned black after clicking the player's avatar in the chat and returning to the game under Galaxy War gameplay.
4. Fixed the bug that the check box of the gene transformation function of the Biological cabin did not move with the icon.
5. The instruction of Commander Items has been added to the tutorial in Chapter 1.
6. Optimized the button prompt to start the game after the first appearance customization.
7. Now, when you turn off or cancel the Explore function of the Adventure, the currently explored element will be located.
8. Save the skipped battle state of the arms race on your device.
9. Optimized the tutorial for the first time of wearing Fashion.
10. Improved the fluency of the list and other interfaces.
11. Added the detailed pop-up window after clicking some icon of some items.
12. Optimized layout of some interface.
13. Optimized some description text.
14. Modified the wrong description of talent Resonator.

notes.title: ========Version Update Notice========
notes.content:
Dear commanders, we will update the game version in the near future.

Preview of version update content
Function Adjustment
1.New cross server legion combat game play: Galaxy War
A)The legion leader and the deputy leader can start matching, a map will be generated based on the opponent matched.
B)The war zone map is a hexagonal grid map full of fog, which is the same shape as the map of Adventure.
C)Each legion member has a fixed number of action chances in each map. When rematching the opponent legion, the action chances will also be reset.
D)Each time a member explores the map, 1 action chance is consumed. The exploration could uncover the fog on the selected block and trigger elemental events under the fog, such as obtaining score, activating the temple, or discovering enemy ships, etc. Attacking enemy ship will consume 1 action chance.
E)Different scores can be obtained according to the event, and the scores of each member are finally summarized into the total scores of the legion.
F)Finally, the corresponding legion rewards will be issued according to the total scores ranking of the legion.

2.Added main quest progress ranking information.

System Optimization
1.Optimized the order of Fashions. When a new fashion is available, this fashion will be at the top.
2.Fixed a bug where you need to re-start the game to see the equipment after purchasing a Lv. 25 package.
3.The respawning of drift box will be shown in the Report in the adventure.
4.Fixed the bug that when there are three deputy leaders in the legion, one of them cannot be appointed as the leader of the legion.
5.You can check the information of unlocked items in the War Support store.
6.Changed the hairstyles of Flame Dancer and Bounty Hunter.

8.Optimized the event interface.
